_comment: Sowcast analysis sites. 'pin' = the map pin used by the prototype app (public/data/regions/index.json). 'field' = the point we actually sample, moved off town centres onto MODIS-classified cropland. Run `node data/scripts/00_verify_sites.mjs` to re-check / auto-correct 'field' points.

sites.name: Story County
sites.note: Pin is on the town of Ames (MODIS land cover = 13 urban). Field point ~9 km NE is cropland (class 12).

sites.name: Ludhiana District
sites.note: Pin is on Ludhiana city (SoilGrids has no data there). Field point SW of the city is cropland (class 12).

sites.name: Nakuru County
sites.note: Pin is on Nakuru town. Field point near Rongai is cropland / cropland mosaic (classes 12/14, 2019-2022). Equatorial: two rainy seasons, treat hemisphere loosely.

sites.name: Darling Downs
sites.note: Pin is on Toowoomba (class 13 urban). MODIS often labels dryland grain/fallow here as grassland (10); 00_verify_sites.mjs searches for the nearest class-12 pixel. [auto-moved 2.62 km to nearest MODIS cropland pixel by 00_verify_sites.mjs]
